## Summary
Provides runtime metrics helpers for collecting RTT samples, merging metrics batches, normalizing timestamps, and periodically reporting metrics batches. The package owns the configuration defaults and worker loops used by these metric collection and reporting components.

## Responsibilities
- Define metric collection, reporting, and timestamp normalization configuration.
- Collect publisher, subscriber, and relay RTT samples into metrics batches.
- Merge externally produced metrics batches and periodically emit non-empty batches.
- Normalize metric timestamps using one-way delay estimation before downstream handling.
